sections.title: Information Collected
sections.content: Krovaa may collect information such as name, email address, phone number, account details, device information, and platform activity.

sections.title: Use of Information
sections.content: Information may be used to operate the platform, verify accounts, facilitate transactions, improve services, and maintain security.

sections.title: Payment Information
sections.content: Payments may be processed through third-party payment providers. Krovaa does not store sensitive payment details such as credit card numbers.

sections.title: Data Protection
sections.content: Krovaa implements reasonable security measures to protect user information.

sections.title: Information Sharing
sections.content: Krovaa does not sell user data and may share information only with service providers necessary for operating the platform.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.content: The platform may use cookies and similar technologies to enhance user experience and analyze usage.

sections.title: Policy Updates
sections.content: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically.

sections.title: Platform Nature
sections.content: Krovaa operates as an online technology platform that enables users to connect, communicate, and transact with one another. Krovaa is not a party to agreements made between users.

sections.title: User Accounts
sections.content: Users must provide accurate information when creating an account and are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials.

sections.title: Platform Usage
sections.content: Users agree to use the platform only for lawful purposes and must not engage in fraud, abuse, harassment, unauthorized access, or any activity that disrupts the platform.

sections.title: Payments and Wallet
sections.content: Krovaa may facilitate payments through its platform and may maintain a wallet or payment system for transactions between users. Users may add funds to their wallet and use them for transactions on the platform.

sections.title: Platform Fees
sections.content: Krovaa may charge and deduct a platform service fee or commission from transactions processed through the platform.

sections.title: Withdrawals
sections.content: Users may request withdrawal of available wallet balances. Withdrawal requests will be processed within a reasonable timeframe subject to payment provider and banking processes.

sections.title: Service Disclaimer
sections.content: Krovaa does not provide, control, or guarantee services or products exchanged between users. Krovaa is not responsible for the quality, legality, delivery, or outcome of transactions between users.

sections.title: Account Suspension
sections.content: Krovaa reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or misuse the platform.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.content: Krovaa shall not be liable for disputes, losses, damages, or claims arising from user interactions or transactions conducted through the platform.

sections.title: Changes to Terms
sections.content: Krovaa may update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of any updates.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For questions regarding these Terms, contact: support@krovaa.com
